Operating profit margins are moderate at 7.3% (EBIT of $258M) and return on assets stands at a respectable 4.7%, indicating stable investment-grade profitability and financial flexibility. These metrics align with a mid-tier investment-grade profile, balancing modest operating margins against a sound balance sheet and manageable debt burden.

DECISION: BBB
